desc:
"Slifer the Sky Dragon" + "The Winged Dragon of Ra" + "Obelisk the Tormentor"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards from your field and/or GY. (You do not use "Polymerization".)
● This card is unaffected by other cards' effects.
● Gains 1000 ATK/DEF for each card in your hand.
● Once per turn: You can destroy all other monsters on the field, then inflict 1000 damage to your opponent for each destroyed monster.
● If this card leaves the field: You can Special Summon 1 "Slifer the Sky Dragon", 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra", and 1 "Obelisk the Tormentor" from your hand, Deck, GY, or banished zone, ignoring their summoning conditions.
